scope.policy: Exact location codes observed in this corpus only; no extrapolated, unresolved KORAIL, or Incheon mappings are emitted.

extraction.byteOffsets: zero-based offsets in the 52-byte SFI 3 record

stationToken.encoding: four packed-BCD bytes represented as eight decimal characters
stationToken.warning: Do not parse stationToken as hexadecimal and do not equate legacyRawId to a current public station ID.

sources.title: 서울시 대중교통 및 지하철 1회권 승하차 데이터 - 지하철정보.csv sample
CardBal Korean trips corpus used for observed-code coverage

eventDependence.result: none observed and none required by these mappings
eventDependence.note: Boarding, alighting, and flagged records retain the same station identity. Event remains transaction semantics, not station-key semantics.

negativeControls.example: mode 203 legacyRawId 320 is Sangsu (public 2624), while current public station ID 320 is Euljiro 3-ga
00009710 is packed decimal raw ID 971, not hexadecimal integer 38672

negativeControls.test: key by stationToken without transport mode
negativeControls.note: The lack of a rail-only collision in this snapshot is not a namespace guarantee; the six-byte exact locationCode retains the KOTRIS mode.

negativeControls.test: reuse the capital packed-BCD formula for every rail mode
negativeControls.note: Other regional rail records in the same corpus use different token layouts. Decoder selection must be transport-mode-specific.

integrationPolicy.stableMappings: Use the 141 entries whose mapping.confidence is high, keyed by exact 12-character locationCode. Event is not part of the key.
integrationPolicy.reviewMappings: The three medium-high entries (mode 201 raw IDs 113 and 117; mode 203 raw ID 425) are internally consistent but should remain visibly inferred or feature-flagged until a historical AFC codebook is sourced.
integrationPolicy.doNotEmit: Unresolved mode 202 KORAIL and mode 204 Incheon mappings are deliberately absent.
integrationPolicy.provenanceDisplay: Label current station metadata as official and the legacy CardBal-to-current-ID relation as an inferred crosswalk.
